about: Provenance of the open datasets bundled with scalegeom. Rebuild with scripts/build_datasets.py.

datasets.name: nc_tracts
datasets.content: 2,660 North Carolina census tracts; median household income, total population, share of households with broadband, share of adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree; county codes; centroids; queen and rook contiguity; simplified polygons

sources.access: Census Data API (https://api.census.gov/data/2023/acs/acs5) or data.census.gov table export

sources.product: 2023 cartographic boundary file, census tracts, North Carolina (cb_2023_37_tract_500k)

datasets.licence: Public domain (work of the U.S. government)
datasets.crs: EPSG:32119 (NAD83 / North Carolina) for centroids; EPSG:4326 for the simplified polygons
datasets.processing: scripts/build_datasets.py: join on GEOID, project, centroids, contiguity from polygons, polygons simplified at 100 m
caveats: ACS values are survey estimates; margins of error are not included
median_income is a tract median; aggregated values are weighted means of medians, not regional medians

datasets.name: etopo_blue_ridge
datasets.content: Elevation in metres, 160 x 160 cells at 1 arc-minute, 34.70 to 37.35 N, 83.70 to 81.05 W

sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

datasets.licence: Public domain (work of the U.S. government)
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 grid; cells about 1.85 km by 1.51 km at 36 N
datasets.processing: scripts/build_datasets.py: ERDDAP subset, first 160 x 160 cells from the north-west corner
caveats: geographic cells are slightly anisotropic in metres

datasets.name: simulated
datasets.content: Scenarios A and B of Vaz (2026), generated from seeds by scalegeom.simulate
